feeds.title: NYC Single Mom Blog
feeds.description: Linda Grant, the creative force behind NYC Single Mom.com curates a lifestyle site brimming with entertainment, travel, tech, and lifestyle products. As a family lifestyle and adoptive parenting expert, she shares invaluable parenting tips, dining recommendations, travel insights, and NYC-centric events. Through her expertise, advocacy, and brand partnerships, Linda empowers readers with practical solutions for everyday challenges, enriching their lives with useful information and products.

feeds.title: Motherhood Later
feeds.description: Motherhood Later.. Than Sooner, founded by Robin Gorman Newman, is an international organization for women who had a baby over 35. Our mission is to support, empower, inform and connect midlife mothers through our website, blog, newsletter, learning opportunities, online communities for later moms, and in-person events for midlife mothers and families.

feeds.title: The New York Times » Parenting
feeds.description: This section of the New York Times features articles on healthy and gentle parenting advice. The New York Times is dedicated to helping people understand the world through on-the-ground, expert and deeply reported independent journalism. Our vision is to become the essential subscription for every curious, English-speaking person seeking to understand and engage with the world.

feeds.title: New York Jewish Parenting Guide
feeds.description: The New York Jewish Parenting Guide is the go-to resource for Jewish parents. We are an all-encompassing guide full of local and national resources, parents news and tips. Our website includes articles on recreational family outings, summer camp, schools, healthcare, education, nutritional guidance, sports, theater, special needs, calendar of events and more.

feeds.title: ADDitude Mag » ADHD Parenting
feeds.description: ADDitude Magazine is the nation's leading destination for families and adults living with attention deficit disorder (ADHD) and learning disorders.

feeds.title: Psychology Today » Parenting
feeds.description: Singletons and the singular issues that affect family life and parenting no matter how many children you have or may have in the future. In this blog, you will find parenting tips and advice.

feeds.title: Mommy Shorts
feeds.description: With style, grace, and an awesome name to boot, Mommy Shorts is one inspiring blog. Run by busy New York City mom Ilana, Mommy Shorts features tons of unbelievable parenting wisdom, endless amounts of entertaining wit, and enough family cuteness to completely knock your socks off.

feeds.title: A Child Grows
feeds.description: A Child Grows is the largest parenting website in Brooklyn, NY, and one of the best-known parenting blogs in the NYC area. It's considered the go-to resource for Brooklyn families and we are always striving to have the most up-to-date and relevant information for parents in Brooklyn. Learn about parenting resources, schools, camps, classes, neighborhood news, family-friendly events, gear, trends, and everything in between.

feeds.title: Dad and Buried
feeds.description: Dad and Buried is a parenting blog for parents who love their kids but hate parenting. This blog will feature links, photos, memes, vemes, and status updates designed to make you laugh and helps you to cope up with parenting pressures.

feeds.title: City Dads Group
feeds.description: The City Dads Group is an organization dedicated to helping fathers socialize and support one another within active local dads groups and online.

feeds.title: Adoptive Families
feeds.description: Adoptive Families, the award-winning national adoption magazine, is the leading adoption information source for families before, during and after adoption.
